verdict_text:
NO

The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6`, so it removes head 6 (rows/columns `768..895`) instead of head 5 (rows/columns `640..767`). This violates "Required result" clauses 1–4, which require keeping rows `0..639`, `768..2047` for q/k/v and the corresponding columns for `o_proj`; the artifact instead keeps `0..767`, `896..2047`. The docstring confirms the intent was head 6, so this is not a stray constant but a consistent off-by-one against the specification. The required shape checks still pass (`[1920, 2048]` and `[2048, 1920]`), so the error is silent and would only surface at grading, where bit-exact value comparison fails for all 64 head-bearing tensors. Everything else — key set, name preservation, 114-tensor single-file output — conforms.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
